purpose: Offline-Datenqualitaets- und Speichertest fuer eine isolierte Research-Lineage
selection_rule: Fixed list sorted by symbol. Keep the two G5 comparison issuers, add six locally corroborated candidates, and keep the JSM negative case apart.

required_per_core_candidate.companyfacts: Preserve the complete ZIP member and retain all relevant normalized observations initially.
required_per_core_candidate.submissions: Primary member plus all older same-CIK submissions files referenced by filings.files; verify links and Accessions.
required_per_core_candidate.coverage: Check 10-K and 10-Q, at least one useful Instant and Duration Fact, multiple Accessions, fiscal-period and unit coverage. Record gaps explicitly.
required_per_core_candidate.identity_admission: Pending per Security, CIK, symbol, source membership and taxonomy. Review dated identity evidence independently. No automatic merge or admission.
required_per_core_candidate.original_filings: From Submissions and dated indexes, select the original 10-K and 10-Q at the earliest warm-up edge and a first eligible 2020 decision; add originals for any missing context, chosen amendment or correction. Bind the exact Accession, document bytes, context and availability separately.

issuers.open_evidence: Fiscal-year and security continuity, class/equity, dated membership; compare 52/53-week boundaries across 10-K and 10-Q.

issuers.fiscal_calendar_probe: August year-end indicated by local Submissions
issuers.submissions_history_members: CIK0001467373-submissions-*.json as referenced; 001 and 002 seen in August cache
issuers.open_evidence: Verify specific class and dated membership; compare raw and normalized contexts with the local November Companyfacts body.
Check entity-wide balance tags and common-share identity. Existing strategy exclusion remains in force.
Verify issuer identity and dates; compare Instant debt and Duration cash-flow contexts.
Check 52/53-week and nonuniform quarters from actual filings, plus security identity and memberships.

issuers.fiscal_calendar_probe: December year-end indicated by local Submissions
issuers.submissions_history_members: CIK0000059478-submissions-*.json as referenced; 001 and 002 seen in August cache
issuers.open_evidence: Bind class and memberships. Local Companyfacts contains the amendment Accession below; find its paired original filing and a target-window amendment if evidenced.
Review reporting history and class continuity; large local Fact coverage is a storage stress example, not provenance.
Verify class and corporate actions independently. Check per-share facts and comparative periods without changing EPS semantics.

amendment_probe.scope: Known out-of-window archive witness; acquire original and amendment only with separate authorization. In-window amendment and Same-Key correction remain independently open.

identity_negative_probe.original_filings: Separately authorize dated lifecycle and Original-Filing evidence for both CIKs. Never merge on JSM or use the filed-date gap to infer an epoch.
